rationale: This is a mechanical weakest-link stacking of two archive winners whose legs (cash share of current assets and non-cash-claims per sales) are near-mirror images of each other, so the "complements vs substitutes" test is largely uninformative and the triple MIN mostly narrows the effective sample to a corner rather than adding a new economic channel.

This is a well-diagnosed structural repair — restoring the profitability main effect that ProfitGatedLiquidityState discarded while retaining the profit-conditional liquidity term — and the additive form is genuinely different from the rank-MIN family rather than a cosmetic tweak, though part of the resulting FMB slope will simply be the known gross-profitability premium.

This is a one-parameter threshold variant of the archived ProfitGatedLiquidityState that retains the exact defect diagnosed there — no profitability main effect, hence a near-zero FMB slope — so it cannot improve the joint cross-sectional/portfolio objective regardless of gate stringency.

The rescaling of depreciation by the profit it is charged against is a substantive response to the capital-intensity confound in the gen-3 signal, but the two legs are mechanically opposed (oibdp raises the first rank while lowering the second), so the MIN may select an unstable middle band rather than "conservative but cash-profitable" firms and the result will need careful diagnosis.

Taxable-income confirmation of book earnings is the well-documented book-tax-difference earnings-quality anomaly (Lev–Nissim, Hanlon), and as constructed the level of txp/lct is itself largely a profitability proxy, so the MIN risks collapsing into a rescaled earnings-to-assets sort rather than an independent corroboration channel.

The ablation is honestly motivated as a discriminating test between a cash-holdings premium and accrual realization, but the separation is imperfect because (act−che)/at is mechanically depressed by large cash balances, so a positive result would not cleanly exclude the cash explanation and the signal itself overlaps the archived lean-claims variants.
